steps.en: Searched notices are shown with key details
steps.id: Notice hasil pencarian tampil dengan detail utama
steps.why_en: Generic notice search exists but has no reduction action.
steps.why_id: Pencarian notice umum ada tetapi tidak punya aksi reduction.

steps.why_en: Only an external system can send a dollar reduction; no OCMS screen for it.
steps.why_id: Hanya sistem eksternal yang bisa kirim reduction nominal; tidak ada layar OCMS.

steps.why_en: No percentage input or calculation exists in the system.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada input atau perhitungan persentase di sistem.

steps.en: The reduction formula is maintained in a parameter table
steps.id: Rumus reduction dikelola di parameter table
steps.why_en: Rules are fixed in program code; no formula table exists.
steps.why_id: Aturan tertanam di program; tidak ada tabel rumus.

steps.en: The system computes and shows the reduced amount automatically
steps.id: Sistem menghitung dan menampilkan jumlah setelah reduction otomatis
steps.why_en: The amount is computed outside; the system only checks and stores it.
steps.why_id: Jumlah dihitung di luar; sistem hanya memeriksa dan menyimpannya.
